p: Melita: That place which we today call Malta.
And when Paul had gathered a: The godly are sure to have danger upon danger, but they alway have a glorious outcome.

And when the barbarians saw the: Although adversity is the punishment of sin, yet seeing that God in punishing men does not always punish because of sin, they judge rashly who either do not wait for the end, or who judge and esteem of men according to prosperity or adversity.
vengeance suffereth not to live: Right and proper.

swollen: The Greek word signifies to be inflamed or to swell: moreover, Dioscorides in his sixth book, chap. 38, witnesses that the biting of a viper causes a swelling of the body, and so says Nicander, in his remedies against poisons.
but after they had looked a: There are none who are more changing in every way than they who are ignorant of true religion.
In the same quarters were possessions: It never yet was a regret to any man who received the servant of God, were he ever so miserable and poor.
So when this was done: Although Paul was a captive, yet the power of God was not captive.
Who also honoured us with many: God does well to strangers for his children's sake.
And after three months we departed: Idols do not defile the saints, who do in no way give consent of them.
sign was Castor and Pollux: So they used to deck the front part of their ships, because of which their ships were called by such names.
Where we found brethren: God bows and bends the hearts even of profane men, as it pleases him to show favour to his own.
And from thence: God never allows his own to be afflicted beyond their strength.
Appii forum: Appius was a paved road made by Appius the blind, with the help of his soldiers, long and broad, and it ran out towards the sea, and there were three taverns on it.
himself with a soldier that kept: Not in a common prison, but in a house which he rented for himself.
And it came to pass: Paul in every place remembers himself to be an apostle.
But when the Jews spake against: We may use the means which God gives us, but in such a way that we seek the glory of God, and not of ourselves.
And when they had appointed him: The Law and the Gospel agree well together.
testified the kingdom of God: With good reasons, and proved that the kingdom of God foretold to them by the Prophets had come.
And some believed the things which: The Gospel is a taste of life to those that believe, and a taste of death to those that are disobedient.
Saying: The unbelievers willingly resist the truth, and yet not by chance.
closed: They made as though they did not see that which they saw against their desires: yea, they did see, but they would not see.
Be it known therefore unto you: The unbelief of the reprobate and castaways cannot cause the truth of God to be of no effect.
And when he had said these: Not the Gospel, but the contempt of the Gospel is the cause of strife and debate.
And Paul dwelt two whole years: The word of God cannot be bound.
